title: Episode title — United's Record Revenue Can't Beat Delta's Math, Lufthansa Invades Columbus, and American's Having a Week
summary: United posted record revenue but Delta still out-profited them by a mile — we break down why that gap matters. Plus, Lufthansa plants its flag in Columbus, Ohio of all places, American pays flight attendants for a catering disaster while also banning a guy from taking window photos, and a typhoon takes aim at Asian hubs.
